name: emu-pager-screens
description: One Virtual Pager firmware node (SSD1680 250x122 e-paper profile, GPS-capable) on the ether. Uses the default e-paper pager node binary (emulator/node/build/bramble-node.elf), so the emulator streams a 250x122 monochrome framebuffer. A single node keeps screen navigation deterministic for the pager-screens e2e capture: it never receives a message, so nothing auto-switches its screen out from under the button-driven walk through Main / Messages / Nodes / Stats / GPS / Settings. It still autosends a broadcast (stored in its own message log) so the Messages screen has content, and its GPS gate opens so the broker feeds it a fix (canonical documentation coordinates at slot origin) for the GPS screen. This is the e-paper analogue of emu-heltec-oled.json. Build the node binary first: make -C emulator node.
